family.tagline: School at the kitchen table, and the lessons stay home.
family.story: Valentina teaches Emil and Sofia at the kitchen table and writes a weekly newsletter about it. Henrik works from home as a product manager. One Companion Core in the living room keeps the lessons, the notes and the newsletter in the house.

members.name: Valentina
members.work: leads the homeschool days, writes a newsletter

companion.name: Greta
companion.job: Drafts the weekly newsletter and day plans from what Valentina texts it.
companion.limits: Drafts only. Valentina sends the newsletter.

companion.name: Magnus
companion.job: Opens Joplin in its own browser and files Henrik's meeting notes.
companion.limits: Files notes Henrik names. He checks the folder.

popup.title: The parcel crosses the kitchen
popup.body: A parcel waits in the front hall. Henrik carries it past the kitchen to the living room, where Emil has cleared a shelf.

popup.title: Sofia reads out the list
popup.body: Sofia reads the list aloud: the Companion Core, a power cable, a quick-start guide and a recovery USB drive. The Core covers about three quarters of a sheet of paper.

popup.title: Emil plugs in the Core
popup.body: Emil plugs in the power cable, and Valentina presses the button. The Core wakes and opens its own Wi-Fi network.

popup.title: Henrik joins from his phone
popup.body: Henrik opens the Wi-Fi settings and joins the Core's own network. Next he picks the home network and types its password.

popup.title: Agents first, then the apps
popup.body: In Companion Hub, Valentina picks Hermes and Henrik picks OpenClaw. They add Companion Memory (beta), Kiwix and Joplin Server, then walk away.

beats.capability: runs in its own sandbox on your Core and talks to you through the messaging platform you pick

popup.title: Greta says good morning
popup.body: Valentina texts the agent she named Greta. Greta answers, and the Core is running.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: valentina
say.text: Good morning, Valentina. I am Greta. Shall we plan the week?

beats.capability: Listen to your audiobooks and podcasts, and pick up where you left off on any device

popup.title: Tonight's story, where it stopped
popup.body: Sofia picks tonight's story in Audiobookshelf and settles on the couch. The app remembers where the last chapter stopped.

beats.capability: Keeps your digital life on your own disk, so your agents know your context; imports are opt-in

popup.title: She decides what Memory reads
popup.body: Valentina chooses what Companion Memory (beta) may read: the lesson notes, nothing else. Greta drafts from those notes, and Valentina can revoke the connection at any time.

beats.capability: Write a wiki or a set of manuals in books, chapters and pages, with search and history

popup.title: The curriculum, in books and chapters
popup.body: Valentina writes the curriculum in BookStack: a book for each term, a chapter for each unit. Search and page history keep every revision.

beats.capability: Track the pantry, shopping lists, recipes, chores

popup.title: Pantry check before shopping day
popup.body: Before shopping day, Emil and Sofia check the pantry in Grocy. Each adds one missing item to the list.

beats.capability: Split shared costs with housemates, family or friends and settle up with the fewest payments

popup.title: Sharing the science kit, fairly
popup.body: Two homeschool families share a science kit. Henrik logs the cost in Spliit at the counter, and it shows who owes whom.

beats.capability: runs in its own sandbox on your Core and talks to you through the messaging platform you pick

popup.title: Greta drafts the weekly issue
popup.body: At the school table, Valentina texts Greta her lesson notes. Greta drafts the week's newsletter, and Valentina edits every line.

say.speaker: valentina
say.text: Here is the issue as a draft. Please read it first.

beats.capability: Write and send newsletters to your own mailing list

popup.title: Friday's issue goes into Listmonk
popup.body: Valentina builds Friday's issue in Listmonk and checks the subscriber list. She presses send herself.

beats.capability: Merge, split, compress and convert PDFs on your own Core

popup.title: A week of worksheets, one pack
popup.body: Valentina merges the week's worksheets into one printable pack with Stirling-PDF. The merge runs on the Core.

beats.capability: A real-time Kanban board for a team or a family project

popup.title: The next six issues, planned
popup.body: Valentina keeps the next six issues on a Planka board. Each card moves from idea to draft to sent.

beats.capability: Take notes and keep to-dos that sync across your devices through your own server

popup.title: Magnus files the meeting notes
popup.body: Henrik pastes his meeting notes into chat and names a folder. Magnus files them in Joplin Server in its own browser, and Henrik checks the folder.

say.speaker: henrik
say.text: Filed in the product folder. Please check it.

beats.capability: Run a quiz night for a small group on your own Core

popup.title: Friday quiz night, written by Emil
popup.body: On Friday, Emil writes the questions in Razzia. The whole family plays at the school table.

beats.capability: Turn habits and chores into a game with levels and quests

popup.title: Reading done, level gained
popup.body: Emil ticks off his reading, and Habitica gives his character a level. The quest list lives on the Core.

beats.capability: Read Wikipedia and other reference sites from files kept on your Core

popup.title: How a volcano works
popup.body: Sofia looks up how volcanoes work in Kiwix at the upstairs desk. The articles open from files saved on the Core.

beats.capability: Block ads, trackers and bad domains for every device on your network at the DNS level

popup.title: Ads blocked for the whole house
popup.body: In the utility room, Henrik points the home network at Pi-hole. It blocks ads and trackers at the DNS level for every device on the Wi-Fi.

beats.capability: Track your plants, watering and care history across rooms and beds, with photos and a garden journal

popup.title: The lettuce keeps a diary
popup.body: Sofia waters the lettuce planters on the deck. Emil logs the date in HortusFox, so the lettuce has a diary.

beats.capability: Stream your own music collection to any device

popup.title: Supper over, music on the deck
popup.body: After supper, the family plays its own music on the deck. Navidrome streams the collection from the Core to a phone.

popup.title: One Core, one school day
popup.body: The Aguirre-Lund household teaches, writes and plans from one Core in the living room.

closing.body: Your lessons, your notes and your weekly newsletter can run on a Companion Core at home. Browse the Companion Hub store and pick your first apps.

notes: FTUE follows the owner's hotspot flow (STORY-BIBLE section 7); owner sign-off against the fact sheet is still open.

Homeschool family: no claim about learning outcomes, grades or child safety anywhere. The children use Audiobookshelf, Habitica, Kiwix, Razzia and HortusFox in everyday moments, third person, never voiced and never monitored.
No TV in this house: the media beat sits on the couch. No island: the kitchen beats say "the counter". No garden zone of 10 m2: the garden chapter uses the planters and the deck.

Greta has memory true (cast). living-memory shows the opt-in: only the lesson notes are connected, and the connection can be revoked. Magnus is OpenClaw working inside Joplin Server on the Core, so the website note is not needed.
dining-listmonk: Listmonk needs an outside mail server to send (catalog caveat). The beat says Valentina presses send herself and promises no delivery.
Invented place and street: check Aspenholt and Spruce Tangle Drive against a map.
